summary: TASK-07 full-regression validation against the public preview URL. All 6 sprint smoke suites (Sprint 00..05) pass on the live tenant (TENANT-000001) + cross-tenant (RIYADAH-DOH-001). A new targeted regression for the closing-the-loop feature (`integration_service._latest_report`, `croms_damage_summary`, `maintenance_handoff`) was added at /app/backend/tests/test_closing_the_loop.py and PASSES end-to-end: (1) before report generation, /integrations/croms/rental-agreements/{ra}/damage-summary returns reportReference=null + evidencePackageReference=null; (2) after generating RENTAL_DAMAGE_SUMMARY_REPORT + EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_REPORT, both refs are auto-populated with {reportId, reportType}; (3) POST /integrations/maintenance/handoffs with NO caller-supplied evidencePackageReference auto-populates evidencePackageReference (latest EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_REPORT for the case's inspection session) + reportReference (latest DAMAGE_CASE_REPORT for the case); (4) idempotent replay (same X-Idempotency-Key) returns identical maintenanceHandoffId + identical evidencePackageReference + reportReference; (5) caller-supplied evidencePackageReference is preserved (not overwritten) while reportReference is still auto-linked from the DAMAGE_CASE_REPORT; (6) no raw objectPath / http(s) URL leaks in any payload; (7) ownership boundary (finalCustomerChargeDecision==NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE, workOrderExecutionOwnedBy==GCU365Maintenance) preserved. Frontend smoke against the preview: login no pre-fill (email='', pwd len=0), Dashboard renders dashboard-metrics + card-integration-health with CROMS / Handoffs / Callbacks / Idempotency / Tenant-scope / Unauthorized counters, Reports page (reports-root) renders 18 report-row entries + 18 report-access-link buttons (clicking emits 'Access link opened (expires in Ns)' UI feedback), Damage Cases list shows 14 total with the latest auto-link test case (VEH-CTL-20DF1F33) at the top, Inspections + Review Queue pages mount with no console errors and no crashes.
verified_acceptance_criteria: Sprint 01 smoke: inspection session create+get, upload-request -> signed PUT -> register image (+ idempotent), signed evidence access link, cross-tenant 404, unsigned/forged URL 403, invalid status transition rejected, unknown route 404.

Sprint 02 smoke: thresholds default+update+validation, image quality (real Gemini 3.5-flash), AI analysis (real Gemini 3.1-pro-preview) status=COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS, findings query + cross-tenant 404, retry, unknown route 404.

Sprint 03 smoke: no-baseline comparison NOT_COMPARABLE + auto-route, review queue (reason-required 400, CONFIRMED + additional-evidence), damage case create + duplicate 409 + lifecycle/history + terminal 409 + cross-tenant 404, baseline auto-anchor, per-vehicle strip with NO raw URLs, AI auto-route field present.

Sprint 04 smoke: CROMS check-out idempotent replay + IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT 409, check-in baseline linked, damage-summary finalCustomerChargeDecision=NOT_OWNED_BY_DAMAGE_INTELLIGENCE, inspection status, damage case from comparison, Maintenance handoff SENT + idempotent replay, work-order reference linked (workOrderExecutionOwnedBy=GCU365Maintenance), repair status + rejection + additional-evidence, handoff-status aggregation with NO raw URLs, non-integration principal 403, cross-tenant 404, missing case 404.

Sprint 05 smoke: monitoring metrics + dependency health, INSPECTION_SUMMARY_REPORT + EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_REPORT + RENTAL_DAMAGE_SUMMARY_REPORT all COMPLETED, get/list reports without raw URL/path leaks, signed time-limited access-link serves report 200 + tampered sig 403, inspector role denied (403), cross-tenant get/access 404, validation 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for DAMAGE_CASE_REPORT without damageCaseId, ownership boundary preserved in rental summary, monitoring reports.generated counter increments, CROMS damage-summary auto-links rental damage summary report.

NEW closing-the-loop (test_closing_the_loop.py): pre-generation damage-summary refs are null; post-generation refs auto-link; Maintenance handoff auto-populates evidencePackageReference + reportReference; idempotent replay returns same stored refs; caller-supplied evidencePackageReference preserved while reportReference auto-linked; no URL leaks; ownership boundaries preserved.

Frontend smoke: login pre-fill removed; Dashboard dashboard-metrics + card-integration-health (CROMS / Handoffs / Callbacks / Idempotency / Tenant-scope / Unauthorized) render; Reports page renders report-row-* + report-access-link-* and emits time-limited access link UI feedback; Damage Cases list reflects 14 cases including the new auto-link test case; no console errors / no blank screens.
critical_code_review_comments: integration_service._latest_report uses {tenantId, reportType, status=COMPLETED, ...match} sort by createdAt desc — correctly tenant-scoped and only returns COMPLETED reports. Safe and idempotent.
croms_damage_summary uses {$in: session_ids} on EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_REPORT.inspectionSessionId — correctly covers both check-out and check-in sessions for the rental.

maintenance_handoff preserves caller-supplied evidencePackageReference (only auto-links when not provided); reportReference is always auto-linked from the latest DAMAGE_CASE_REPORT — confirmed in test step 10. Both refs are stored on the handoff doc AND returned in the response AND replayed via idempotency_service.store_result, so replay returns the originally-stored refs.

Stale doc note in /app/memory/test_credentials.md line 88 still says 'login form is pre-filled' — this is now incorrect (Sprint-05 hardening removed pre-fill, verified empty on Login page). Recommend main agent update this line to reflect current behavior.
No raw objectPath / http(s) URL leaks observed across damage-summary, handoff-status, reports get/list responses (asserted in 6 smoke suites + new CTL test).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the executed AC (login no pre-fill, Dashboard metrics + integration health, Reports list+access-link, Damage Cases list, Inspections + Review Queue mount)
